versions.changelog:
Initial release of hermes-self-audit skill:

- Provides scheduled and on-demand audits of Hermes Agent’s internal changes, including skill modifications, curator status, and memory provider health.
- Outputs formatted audit reports to chat platforms (Feishu, Discord, etc.) and saves a local log.
- Designed to help users detect agent self-modification, unexpected skill creation, high-frequency changes, and configuration drift.
- Recommends weekly automated runs via cronjob for ongoing visibility.
- All operations are read-only and non-intrusive for safety and transparency.
